name: QUADRO
author: Matt
description: QUADRO turns the FM-1 into a four-section performance synth after the ARP Quadra: bass, string ensemble, poly and a two-voice lead play at once across a split keyboard. A 14-stage phaser, reverb and delay, one-finger chords, a clock-synced sequencer with a 16-step mode, touch bend and brilliance on the lead, MIDI in with velocity, and 105 programs, the Quadra's own sixteen first.
credits: QUADRO synth, panel, reverb and delay; on fm1-base (MPL-2.0) and felucca-bsp
